# Pierre-Yves Pointereau

> Senior software engineer (front-end) and UI architect in Sydney. Design systems, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), web performance and agent-assisted engineering.

I build the foundations product teams ship on: component libraries, accessibility practice, and fast, stable pages. At Humanitix I created and look after the Svelte component library, led the move to Svelte 5, and built automated accessibility testing against WCAG 2.2. Before that I spent seven years as Front End Architect at News Corp Australia, working on the metro news network and its multi-brand design system. Most of my work now runs through coding agents, with a focus on making their output trustworthy: review and QA agents, verification pipelines, and human sign-off where it matters.
